player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imaray {player_id}. D tira n 15-Puzzle i d-tiray.
Inagraw n urar d asuter n yeḍṛisen iberdan s azrar n wadda seg 1 ar 15, d akal ilemẓiyen yellan deffir tama tayeffust.
I wakken ad teskecem tarmit, tzemreḍ ad tesruḥeḍ ṭayṭ i d-ilemẓi (yettembiwel s snat n tedwiltin, am __) s useqdec n yiwen n iseqdac igan d:
- 'up': Sruḥ ṭayṭ deffir akal ilemẓiyen ɣer ufella.
- 'down': Sruḥ ṭayṭ ufella n akal ilemẓiyen ɣer deffir.
- 'left': Sruḥ ṭayṭ ɣer tama tayeffust n akal ilemẓiyen ɣer tama tazelmaṭ.
- 'right': Sruḥ ṭayṭ ɣer tama tazelmaṭ n akal ilemẓiyen ɣer tama tayeffust.
I wakken ad teskecem tarmit, arki tawṭiḍt (am 'up', 'down', 'left', neɣ 'right') deffir sin n tedwiltin, am [up].
Tasuta n yeḍṛisen n tura tettwabeyyen deffir. Seqdec isalan-a i wakken ad tesulṭuḍ tibuḍt.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ahil ur nlaq ara. Amyurar {player_id} ur d-yerri s uswir i yellan deg tferkawin tiqburin.
invalid_move.illegal_move: Aḥezzeb ur yelhi ara. Taɣawsa n tqecwalt ur tezmir ad tettwasuqqel deg ubrid i d-yettunefken.

outcome.win: Ayyuz! Amur {player_id} yefru s rrbeḥ amsugel n 15.
outcome.turn_limit: Yewweḍ-d uswir n uḥric. Ammudel yekfa {percent} % seg urti
